title: Kaha Shah ne ye rokar mere akbar
body:
KAHA SHEH NE YEH ROKAR- MERE AKBAR ASWS.
KAHA'N HO MERE DILBAR**2.
<<MINI>>
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
1. DIKHAYI KUCH NAHI DETA HAIN BETA..**2.
MAIN AB KHAATA HUN THOKAR.**2.
<<MINI>>
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. KAHUN KYA JAAKE QAIME MEIN BATAO..*2
AGAR POOCHEGI MADAR.**2.
<<MINI>>
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. ZAYEEFI MEIN NA CHODO SAATH MERA..**2.
KARO EHSAAN MUJHOAR..**2.
<<MINI>>
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. ZARA AANKHO'N KO KHOLO KUCH TO BOLO..**2.
<<MINI>>
PIDAR SE APNE UTHKAR..**2.
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. BATAO IS TARHA SEENE PA APNE..**2.
RAKHE HO HAATH KYUNKAR..**2.
<<MINI>>
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. KAHAN PAR DARD HAI KUCH TO BATAO..**2.
<<MINI>>
PIDAR SE APNE UTHKAR..**2.
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. TERI SHADI KA ZAINAB S.A. KO THA ARMAA'N..**2.
ASAR KYA HOGA USPAR..**2.
<<MINI>>
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. BAYAA'N KARTE THE SAAHIL SHAAHE WAALA..**2.
TADAPKAR MERE AKBAR..**2.
<<MINI>>
MERE AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
KAHA SHEH NE YEH ROKAR-MERE AKBAR ASWS.
Kalaam: JANAB ALAMDAR SAHIL SAHAB.
